title: DLMF 4.18 Inequalities: For more inequalities see Mitrinović ( 1964 , pp.
summary: DLMF 4.18 Inequalities: For more inequalities see Mitrinović ( 1964 , pp.
body: NIST DLMF section 4.18 (Inequalities) says: "For more inequalities see Mitrinović ( 1964 , pp. 101–111) , Mitrinović ( 1970 , pp. 235–265) , and Bullen ( 1998 , pp. 250–254) ." Equation 4.18.1 on the page has alt text "\frac{2x}{\pi}\leq\sin x\leq x,". Equation 4.18.2 on the page has alt text "x\leq\tan x,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
